lines.text: Just give in to it and free yourself.
I like to have my body do the talking.
Commander, how about you, Yuni, and I have some fun?
Fufu, so, where do you want to kiss today?

Commander, I need a little excitement today.
What time are you off duty?

You're really starting to understand me, hehe! 
It feels wonderful when you massage that spot.
Commander, I know you're busy, but we should go check on Yuni.

Sitting here watching you is exciting enough for me. 
Just enjoy it...
It's a little too bright here. Not my cup of tea, but... not bad.
Let's hang out at the bar at some point. Should be fun.
The bar? There's a certain pleasure to be had there, yes. Drinks as well.
Don't you know? There's a fine line between pleasure and pain.
Well. I can enjoy the battle a bit more.
Oh... It feels good.
I don't really want to get too strong either.
Are you going to use that on me today? Oh, so it's a gift?
Thank you Commander. Where would you like to hit me?
Thank you for this. I'd like it if you'd give me something else as well. How about it?
Whoo-hoo. What if I fall for you?
The existence of Commander is pure excitement.
Commander, I'm more and more excited.
I'm always ready.
Oh, that's...
Don't pull too hard!
Whoo! Time to have some fun.
I'm not into doing the hitting myself though.
Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.
How far can you push me?
I'll reload it.
Hmm~
It's hard to shoot~
It's my turn.
Come on, give me all you've got.
Hehe! Let's push them around a little bit.
Whoa, I got you.
Seems I've got a knack for this.
Hehe. It's fun.
Yeeoowch!
Great!
Grrahh!
Oh no... I went a little overboard and broke myself...
Whoo-hoo! It lacked a certain pizzazz but I'm satisfied.
